tagline: A broken family under an expat sun that never quite warms the bones.

quotes.text: A melancholy and moving family drama.
Told with humour and enormous compassion… a beguiling story about broken people who have all the feelings and none of the words. Utterly captivating.
quotes.source: Damien Owens, author of Dead Cat Bounce

quotes.text: A trademark sweet-and-sour Mike Leigh film in novel form.

title: Staying On
blurb: A geriatric coming-of-age story about Tony and Laney, an old married couple locked in a silent war about going home to England, or staying on in their expat life. They’re stuck – until their self-possessed daughter-in-law turns up to budge them along, and to solve her own long-buried issues.
Every keystroke of *Staying On* was recorded for the British Library’s Keystroke Project (2014–2018) and the data generated was released on the British Library website for academics to play with.
